method: Official W/L/T labels and final scoreboard totals, defaults retained and flagged; PPG/SHG summed from skaters and PIM includes skaters plus goalies. Two points per win and one per tie are a comparison convention, not an adopted rule for every historical playoff format. Playoff outcome notes require independent historical evidence.
milestoneCaution: Previously reconciled milestone dates reproduce published HTO individual statistics. Games with missing skater statistics prevent an independent certification of actual historical appearances or points; do not invent participation from team scores.
coverageReviewReason: These players appear in the published Summer 2013 skater season tables, and four games in that season lack skater statistics. This flags possible undercounting; it does not prove participation or points in the missing games and does not justify an automatic reversal.
